issues.description: The problem statement/UML requires a parameterless method `getTotalNumberOfStudents(): int`, but the solution defines `getTotalNumberOfStudents(boolean includeGuests): int` instead. This API mismatch means students following the specification will implement a zero-argument method, while the provided reference solution (and any tests based on it) use a boolean parameter and call `getTotalNumberOfStudents(true)` from other methods.
issues.suggestedFix: Change the solution to implement the required `public int getTotalNumberOfStudents()` (no parameters) matching the problem statement/UML, returning `numberOfInscribedStudents + numberOfGuestStudents`. If configurable behavior is intended, add an overload `getTotalNumberOfStudents(boolean includeGuests)` in addition to (not instead of) the parameterless method, and update other methods to call the parameterless version unless the spec is updated accordingly.
